title: Fixed Raised Eye Slot Visor Helmet
description: One complete original fixed raised-visor costume helmet. A thick hollow crowned main shell has a fully open lower neck and one broad actual front face aperture; the separately connected curved face visor is held upward about two finite side pivot axes and contains two genuinely empty horizontal eye slots separated by its centre bridge. A closed crown cap, complete lower neck rim and visible paired pivot caps complete the object. The supplied pose alone is static: no hinge rig, animation, collision, wearer or head insert. It is not the old fixed three-window diving bulb with its glass recoloured, the open wire fencing mask, or a weld hood supported only by head bands; the whole head crown remains beneath the independently raised facial shell. All new geometry, three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, centred ground datum, one model and zero scenes. Invented nonweapon military/fantasy costume appearance only; no fit, precise history or anatomy, visibility performance, working articulation, impact protection, manufacturing or safety claim.
